title: Strict all-or-nothing CSV inventory importer
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag that records parsed before a bad row are built in memory yet not returned. That is the all-or-nothing contract: staging validated rows locally and only extending the caller's store after the whole file passes is exactly how a partial import is prevented while still collecting every row error.
